Interface VirtualServerRmi

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
ServerRmi
public interface VirtualServerRmi extends Remote

Extends Remote so that its methods can be called by clients over the RMI registry. Every method declares RemoteException as required by the RMI specification. Methods that enforce session-timing rules also declare InvalidTimingException so that the client receives a meaningful error when an action is performed out of a sequence.

    • login

      void login(String nickname, VirtualViewRmi clientStub) throws RemoteException, InvalidUsernameException
      Registers a new RMI client session under the given nickname.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the desired player nickname
      clientStub - the client's RMI callback stub for server-to-client events
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the remote call fails
      InvalidUsernameException - if the nickname is already in use

    • createGame

      int createGame(String nickname, int numPlayers) throws RemoteException, InvalidTimingException
      Creates a new game lobby with the specified player capacity.
      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the player creating the lobby
      numPlayers - number of players for the new match
      Returns:
      the unique match ID assigned to the new lobby
      Throws:

    • move

      void move(String nickname, int tileId) throws RemoteException, InvalidMoveException, InvalidTimingException, InvalidPhaseException, InvalidPlayerException, OccupiedTileException
      Places the player's pawn on the specified board tile.
      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the moving player
      tileId - ID of the target tile
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the remote call fails
      InvalidMoveException - if the tile is not valid for the player
      InvalidTimingException - if the player is not in an ongoing match
      InvalidPhaseException - if the player cannot move during the current phase
      InvalidPlayerException - if the player is not the current player
      OccupiedTileException - if the target tile is already occupied
